props.text:
Protocol: 1 byte per event, 8 data bits

bit 7    1 = release, 0 = press
bit 6    1 = RESTORE (not in the matrix)
bit 5-3  matrix row (CIA1 port A bit)
bit 2-0  matrix column (CIA1 port B bit)

Examples
A press 0x0A, A release 0x8A
RESTORE press 0x40, release 0xC0

Do not choose the UART used by the REPL.

code.module:
# C64 KEYBOARD: a virtual Commodore 64 keyboard that sends key events on a UART.
#
# Every C64 key sits at a row and a column of the 8x8 keyboard matrix scanned
# by CIA1. Each press and each release is sent as one byte:
#   bit 7     1 = release, 0 = press
#   bit 6     1 = RESTORE (wired to the NMI line, outside the matrix)
#   bits 5-3  row    (the CIA1 port A bit that selects it)
#   bits 2-0  column (the CIA1 port B bit that reads it)
# So the code of a key is row * 8 + column, RESTORE is 64 (0x40), and a
# release is the code plus 0x80. A press goes out when the finger touches a
# key and the release when it lifts, so holding a key makes the C64 repeat it.
#
# SHIFT, CTRL and C= are one-shot modifiers: one tap holds the modifier down
# until the next key is released, a second tap locks it, a third releases it.
# SHIFT LOCK latches the left SHIFT, like the mechanical key of the C64.
# The UART, baud rate, parity and stop bits are chosen on the Setup page and
# saved to flash.

import json
import time

try:
    from machine import UART
except ImportError:
    UART = None

CONFIG_FILES = ("/flash/c64kbd.json", "c64kbd.json")
BAUDS = (9600, 19200, 38400, 57600, 115200, 230400, 460800, 921600)
PARITY_NAMES = ("N", "E", "O")
PARITY_VALUES = (None, 0, 1)        # machine.UART: None, 0 = even, 1 = odd

RETURN = 1
LSHIFT = 15
RSHIFT = 52
CTRL = 58
CBM = 61                            # the Commodore key
STOP = 63
RESTORE = 64                        # sent with bit 6 set
SHIFT_LOCK = 65                     # virtual: it only latches the left SHIFT
MODS = (LSHIFT, RSHIFT, CTRL, CBM)
CODES = 66

# layout: x and widths are in half key units
X0 = 17
UNIT = 55
KEY_GAP = 5
KY0 = 204
ROW_PITCH = 76
KEY_H = 70

KEY_COLOR = 0x4A3B2F
KEY_TEXT_COLOR = 0xEDE3CF
FKEY_COLOR = 0xC9B79C
FKEY_TEXT_COLOR = 0x3A2E22
PRESSED_COLOR = 0x9A8268
ARMED_COLOR = 0xD9A441
LOCKED_COLOR = 0xC2412D

ECHO_MAX = 600                      # characters kept in the echo buffer
ECHO_LINE = 58                      # characters before a forced line break
TX_SHOWN = 24                       # bytes shown on the TX line
TEST_TEXT = "HELLO"
TEST_CODES = (29, 14, 42, 42, 38, RETURN)

cfg = {"uart": 3, "baud": 4, "parity": 0, "stop": 1}   # baud is an index
uart = None
uart_text = "UART closed"
started = False
on_keyboard = False

sent = bytearray(CODES)             # 1 = the press of that code was sent
mod_state = bytearray(CODES)        # modifiers: 0 off, 1 armed, 2 locked
shift_lock = False
held = -1                           # index of the key under the finger

built = None                        # the panel the keys were created on
styles = []                         # styles must stay referenced
callbacks = []                      # so must the event callbacks
key_objs = []
key_code = []
key_plain = []                      # echo text without and with SHIFT
key_shift = []
echo = "READY.\n"
line_len = 0
tx_log = []


def letter(ch, code):
    return (ch, 2, code, ch, ch.lower())


def key_rows():
    # (matrix row on screen, first x, keys); a key is
    # (legend, width, code, echo text, echo text with SHIFT)
    left = lv.SYMBOL.LEFT
    right = lv.SYMBOL.RIGHT
    up = lv.SYMBOL.UP
    down = lv.SYMBOL.DOWN
    return (
        (0, 0, ((left, 2, 57, "{LARR}", "{LARR}"),
                ("!\n1", 2, 56, "1", "!"), ("\"\n2", 2, 59, "2", "\""),
                ("#\n3", 2, 8, "3", "#"), ("$\n4", 2, 11, "4", "$"),
                ("%\n5", 2, 16, "5", "%"), ("&\n6", 2, 19, "6", "&"),
                ("'\n7", 2, 24, "7", "'"), ("(\n8", 2, 27, "8", "("),
                (")\n9", 2, 32, "9", ")"), ("0", 2, 35, "0", "0"),
                ("+", 2, 40, "+", "+"), ("-", 2, 43, "-", "-"),
                ("GBP", 2, 48, "{POUND}", "{POUND}"),
                ("CLR\nHOME", 2, 51, "{HOME}", "{CLR}"),
                ("INST\nDEL", 2, 0, "\b", "{INST}"))),
        (1, 0, (("CTRL", 3, CTRL, "", ""),
                letter("Q", 62), letter("W", 9), letter("E", 14),
                letter("R", 17), letter("T", 22), letter("Y", 25),
                letter("U", 30), letter("I", 33), letter("O", 38),
                letter("P", 41),
                ("@", 2, 46, "@", "@"), ("*", 2, 49, "*", "*"),
                (up, 2, 54, "^", "{PI}"),
                ("RESTORE", 3, RESTORE, "{RESTORE}", "{RESTORE}"))),
        (2, 0, (("RUN\nSTOP", 2, STOP, "{STOP}", "{RUN}"),
                ("SHIFT\nLOCK", 2, SHIFT_LOCK, "", ""),
                letter("A", 10), letter("S", 13), letter("D", 18),
                letter("F", 21), letter("G", 26), letter("H", 29),
                letter("J", 34), letter("K", 37), letter("L", 42),
                ("[\n:", 2, 45, ":", "["), ("]\n;", 2, 50, ";", "]"),
                ("=", 2, 53, "=", "="),
                ("RETURN", 4, RETURN, "\n", "\n"))),
        (3, 0, (("C=", 2, CBM, "", ""), ("SHIFT", 3, LSHIFT, "", ""),
                letter("Z", 12), letter("X", 23), letter("C", 20),
                letter("V", 31), letter("B", 28), letter("N", 39),
                letter("M", 36),
                ("<\n,", 2, 47, ",", "<"), (">\n.", 2, 44, ".", ">"),
                ("?\n/", 2, 55, "/", "?"),
                ("SHIFT", 3, RSHIFT, "", ""),
                ("CRSR\n" + up + down, 2, 7, "{DOWN}", "{UP}"),
                ("CRSR\n" + left + right, 2, 2, "{RIGHT}", "{LEFT}"))),
        (4, 7, (("", 18, 60, " ", " "),)),
        (0, 33, (("F1\nF2", 3, 4, "{F1}", "{F2}"),)),
        (1, 33, (("F3\nF4", 3, 5, "{F3}", "{F4}"),)),
        (2, 33, (("F5\nF6", 3, 6, "{F5}", "{F6}"),)),
        (3, 33, (("F7\nF8", 3, 3, "{F7}", "{F8}"),)),
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- UART

def uart_name():
    return "UART%d  %d  8%s%d" % (cfg["uart"], BAUDS[cfg["baud"]],
                                  PARITY_NAMES[cfg["parity"]], cfg["stop"])


def open_uart():
    global uart, uart_text
    if uart is not None:
        try:
            uart.deinit()
        except Exception:
            pass
    uart = None
    if UART is None:
        uart_text = uart_name() + "  -  no UART here: bytes go to the console"
        return False
    try:
        port = UART(cfg["uart"])
        port.init(baudrate=BAUDS[cfg["baud"]], bits=8,
                  parity=PARITY_VALUES[cfg["parity"]], stop=cfg["stop"])
        uart = port
        uart_text = uart_name() + "  -  open"
        return True
    except Exception as err:
        uart_text = uart_name() + "  -  error: " + str(err)
        return False


def send_byte(b):
    global uart_text
    if uart is not None:
        try:
            uart.write(bytes((b,)))
        except Exception as err:
            uart_text = uart_name() + "  -  write error: " + str(err)
    else:
        print("TX %02X" % b)
    tx_log.append("%02X" % b)
    if len(tx_log) > TX_SHOWN:
        del tx_log[0]


def set_down(code, down):
    # send a press or a release, only when the state of the key changes
    if sent[code] == down:
        return
    sent[code] = down
    send_byte(code if down else code | 0x80)


def clamp(value, low, high):
    if not isinstance(value, int):
        return low
    return low if value < low else high if value > high else value


def load_config():
    for path in CONFIG_FILES:
        try:
            with open(path) as f:
                data = json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            continue
        cfg["uart"] = clamp(data.get("uart"), 1, 8)
        cfg["baud"] = clamp(data.get("baud"), 0, len(BAUDS) - 1)
        cfg["parity"] = clamp(data.get("parity"), 0, 2)
        cfg["stop"] = clamp(data.get("stop"), 1, 2)
        return path
    return None


def save_config():
    for path in CONFIG_FILES:
        try:
            with open(path, "w") as f:
                json.dump(cfg, f)
            return path
        except Exception:
            pass
    return None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- keys

def mod_down(code):
    return mod_state[code] != 0 or (code == LSHIFT and shift_lock)


def paint(code, color):
    i = 0
    while i < len(key_code):
        if key_code[i] == code:
            key_objs[i].set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(color), lv.PART.MAIN)
        i += 1


def sync_mods():
    # send the modifier presses and releases and show their state
    for code in MODS:
        set_down(code, 1 if mod_down(code) else 0)
        if on_keyboard:
            state = mod_state[code]
            paint(code, LOCKED_COLOR if state == 2 else
                  ARMED_COLOR if state == 1 else KEY_COLOR)
    if on_keyboard:
        paint(SHIFT_LOCK, LOCKED_COLOR if shift_lock else KEY_COLOR)


def release_all():
    global shift_lock, held
    held = -1
    shift_lock = False
    code = 0
    while code < CODES:
        mod_state[code] = 0
        set_down(code, 0)
        code += 1
    sync_mods()


def key_press(i):
    global shift_lock, held
    code = key_code[i]
    if code in MODS:
        mod_state[code] = (mod_state[code] + 1) % 3
        sync_mods()
    elif code == SHIFT_LOCK:
        shift_lock = not shift_lock
        sync_mods()
    else:
        if held >= 0:
            key_release(held)
        held = i
        set_down(code, 1)
        echo_key(i)
    show_tx()


def key_release(i):
    global held
    if held != i:
        return
    held = -1
    set_down(key_code[i], 0)
    for code in MODS:
        if mod_state[code] == 1:     # an armed modifier lasts one key
            mod_state[code] = 0
    sync_mods()
    show_tx()


def make_callback(i):
    def callback(e):
        if e.get_code() == lv.EVENT.PRESSED:
            key_press(i)
        else:
            key_release(i)
    return callback


def stop_restore_event(e):
    # RUN/STOP held while RESTORE is pressed: the classic warm reset
    if e.get_code() == lv.EVENT.PRESSED:
        set_down(STOP, 1)
        set_down(RESTORE, 1)
        add_echo("{STOP+RESTORE}")
    else:
        set_down(RESTORE, 0)
        set_down(STOP, 0)
    show_tx()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- echo

def add_echo(text):
    global echo, line_len
    if text == "\b":
        if echo and echo[-1] != "\n":
            echo = echo[:-1]
            line_len -= 1
    else:
        for ch in text:
            if ch == "\n":
                line_len = 0
            elif line_len >= ECHO_LINE:
                echo += "\n"
                line_len = 0
            if ch != "\n":
                line_len += 1
            echo += ch
    if len(echo) > ECHO_MAX:
        echo = echo[-ECHO_MAX:]
    show_echo()


def echo_key(i):
    shifted = mod_down(LSHIFT) or mod_down(RSHIFT)
    text = key_shift[i] if shifted else key_plain[i]
    prefix = ""
    if mod_down(CTRL):
        prefix += "CTRL-"
    if mod_down(CBM):
        prefix += "C=-"
    if prefix and text not in ("\n", "\b", " "):
        if text[0] == "{":
            text = text[1:-1]
        text = "{" + prefix + text + "}"
    add_echo(text)


def show_echo():
    if on_keyboard:
        ui.echo_text.set_text(echo)


def show_tx():
    if on_keyboard:
        ui.echo_hex.set_text("TX: " + " ".join(tx_log) if tx_log else "TX: -")
        ui.echo_status.set_text(uart_text)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- build

def new_style(bg, text):
    style = lv.style_t()
    style.init()
    style.set_bg_color(lv.color_hex(bg))
    style.set_bg_opa(lv.OPA.COVER)
    style.set_radius(6)
    style.set_text_color(lv.color_hex(text))
    style.set_border_side(lv.BORDER_SIDE.BOTTOM)
    style.set_border_width(4)
    style.set_border_color(lv.color_hex(0x2A2019))
    styles.append(style)
    return style


def legend_font(legend):
    if len(legend) == 1:
        return lv.font_montserrat_24
    lines = legend.split("\n")
    if len(lines) == 2 and len(lines[0]) == 1 and len(lines[1]) == 1:
        return lv.font_montserrat_16
    return lv.font_montserrat_14


def build():
    global built, held
    built = ui.kbd
    held = -1
    for items in (styles, callbacks, key_objs, key_code, key_plain, key_shift):
        items.clear()
    lv.screen_active().remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.SCROLLABLE)
    built.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.SCROLLABLE)
    key_style = new_style(KEY_COLOR, KEY_TEXT_COLOR)
    fkey_style = new_style(FKEY_COLOR, FKEY_TEXT_COLOR)
    pressed = lv.style_t()
    pressed.init()
    pressed.set_bg_color(lv.color_hex(PRESSED_COLOR))
    pressed.set_translate_y(2)
    styles.append(pressed)
    for row, x, keys in key_rows():
        for legend, width, code, plain, shifted in keys:
            obj = lv.obj(built)
            obj.remove_style_all()
            obj.add_style(fkey_style if x >= 33 else key_style, lv.PART.MAIN)
            obj.add_style(pressed, lv.PART.MAIN | lv.STATE.PRESSED)
            obj.set_pos(X0 + x * UNIT // 2, KY0 + row * ROW_PITCH)
            obj.set_size(width * UNIT // 2 - KEY_GAP, KEY_H)
            obj.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.SCROLLABLE)
            obj.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.PRESS_LOCK)
            if legend:
                label = lv.label(obj)
                label.set_style_text_font(legend_font(legend), lv.PART.MAIN)
                label.set_style_text_align(lv.TEXT_ALIGN.CENTER, lv.PART.MAIN)
                label.set_text(legend)
                label.center()
            callback = make_callback(len(key_objs))
            callbacks.append(callback)
            for event in (lv.EVENT.PRESSED, lv.EVENT.RELEASED, lv.EVENT.PRESS_LOST):
                obj.add_event_cb(callback, event, None)
            key_objs.append(obj)
            key_code.append(code)
            key_plain.append(plain)
            key_shift.append(shifted)
            x += width
    # the echo text grows upwards from the bottom of a clipping box
    box = lv.obj(ui.echo_bg)
    box.remove_style_all()
    box.set_pos(12, 6)
    box.set_size(776, 114)
    box.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.SCROLLABLE)
    box.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.CLICKABLE)
    ui.echo_text.set_parent(box)
    ui.echo_text.set_width(776)
    ui.echo_text.set_height(lv.SIZE_CONTENT)
    ui.echo_text.set_long_mode(lv.label.LONG_MODE.WRAP)
    ui.echo_text.align(lv.ALIGN.BOTTOM_LEFT, 0, 0)
    for event in (lv.EVENT.PRESSED, lv.EVENT.RELEASED, lv.EVENT.PRESS_LOST):
        ui.btn_stop_restore.add_event_cb(stop_restore_event, event, None)
    ui.btn_stop_restore.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.PRESS_LOCK)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- pages

def enter_keyboard():
    global started, on_keyboard
    if not started:
        started = True
        load_config()
        open_uart()
    on_keyboard = True
    if built is not ui.kbd:      # the page objects are new
        build()
    sync_mods()
    show_echo()
    show_tx()


def leave_keyboard():
    global on_keyboard
    release_all()                # never leave a key down on the C64
    on_keyboard = False


def enter_setup():
    ui.dd_uart.set_selected(cfg["uart"] - 1)
    ui.dd_baud.set_selected(cfg["baud"])
    ui.dd_parity.set_selected(cfg["parity"])
    ui.dd_stop.set_selected(cfg["stop"] - 1)
    ui.setup_msg.set_text(uart_text)
    ui.setup_hex.set_text("")


def apply_setup():
    cfg["uart"] = ui.dd_uart.get_selected() + 1
    cfg["baud"] = ui.dd_baud.get_selected()
    cfg["parity"] = ui.dd_parity.get_selected()
    cfg["stop"] = ui.dd_stop.get_selected() + 1
    open_uart()
    path = save_config()
    saved = ("saved to " + path) if path else "could not be saved"
    ui.setup_msg.set_text(uart_text + "  -  " + saved)


def send_test():
    # type TEST_TEXT and RETURN, leaving the C64 time to scan each event
    del tx_log[:]
    for code in TEST_CODES:
        set_down(code, 1)
        time.sleep_ms(40)
        set_down(code, 0)
        time.sleep_ms(40)
    where = "sent" if uart is not None else "printed to the console (UART not open)"
    ui.setup_hex.set_text("%s + RETURN %s:\n%s" % (TEST_TEXT, where, " ".join(tx_log)))
    ui.setup_msg.set_text(uart_text)

btn_clear_clicked.body:
global echo, line_len
echo = ""
line_len = 0
show_echo()
